sections.title: Fits $60k

sections.line: The cook's walk between refrigerator, sink and range is short and clear.

runs.t: The cook walks between the refrigerator, the range and the sink where the food is washed. With the refrigerator at the hall end and one sink below the window, that walk was too long. The prep sink in the island makes the three legs short.
The aisle is wide enough for an open oven door, and a person can stand at the open dishwasher. The island drain must go through the floor. A plumber must confirm that it can.

24 in

People also walk behind the island seats. That space depends on where the dining table stands, and the table is not in the model. Measure it with tape on the floor.

runs.t: The island seats the two children, with knee room that also fits an adult. The microwave is on a low shelf in the pantry, below the smaller child's shoulder, so no child lifts hot food down.
The children's heights are averages for their ages. Measure them. Whether each child can set a place and get a snack alone is a test for the built kitchen.

sections.line: A rich bright lower and a lighter upper, both high gloss, that can be bought.

The integrated handle is not confirmed. One image on the maker's site shows it. Ask for the detail and a sample front. The colours on this page are approximate: look at real samples in the room, under the skylight.

sections.title: New upstairs floors

sections.line: Everything the kitchen holds today has a place in the new one, by kind, near where it is used.

runs.t: Everything the kitchen holds today has a place in the new one. The list is
things, read from thirteen photographs of the open cabinets, with seven things the owner named. A rule puts each kind in one cabinet, as near as it fits to where it is first used.

The pots are left of the range. The pans and the everything drawer are right of it. The dishes are over the dishwasher and the silverware is beside it. The food is in the pantry, with the snacks on its two low shelves for the children. The cleaning chemicals are under the sink and no food is there. The liquor is over the refrigerator and the medicine is on a high shelf.

The list is not complete: the photographs do not show what was in the dishwasher or behind other things. The sizes are typical sizes. Correct the list, and measure the large things. Whether the family finds each thing is a test for the built kitchen.

sections.title: A place for everything

runs.t: This is the kitchen, the living room and the upstairs floors of a house in Edmonds, drawn from the contractor's cabinet plan and five photographs. It is for a family of four: two adults who cook, and two children of
and
who will grow up in it.

The brief asked for a rich bright lower cabinet and a lighter upper, both high gloss, both with an integrated handle. No store sells that. The design uses IKEA boxes with lacquer fronts that an online maker sprays in any RAL colour. The integrated handle on those fronts is seen in one image only, and the owner must confirm it before an order.

The refrigerator moves to the hall end of the long wall, as the contractor drew it. That move puts the refrigerator far from the only sink, and the first check of the cook's walk failed. A small prep sink in the island corrects it. The old refrigerator alcove becomes an open pantry, with the microwave on a low shelf that the smaller child can reach.
The model also holds what the kitchen keeps:

things, read from photographs of the old cabinets with each door open. A rule gives each thing a place by kind, near where it is first used, with the cleaning chemicals apart from the food. The exploded view in the configurator opens each cabinet and shows them. The list is an estimate and the owner must correct it.

The job is checked against the budget with sales tax and a contingency. To stay inside it, the owner assembles the cabinet boxes and the floor is a plank from a local store. The prices are web prices and store tags. None is a quote.
The configurator at the top of this page shows each option the model holds. Only the recorded design below has verdicts.
